name: Deploy Application to Linux EC2

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install SSH key
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          echo "${{ secrets.EC2_SSH_KEY }}" > ~/.ssh/hybrid-cloud-key.pem
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/hybrid-cloud-key.pem
          ssh-keyscan -H "${{ secrets.EC2_HOST }}" >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts

      - name: Deploy application
        run: |
          scp -i ~/.ssh/hybrid-cloud-key.pem \
            app/index.html \
            ${{ secrets.EC2_USERNAME }}@${{ secrets.EC2_HOST }}:/tmp/index.html

          ssh -i ~/.ssh/hybrid-cloud-key.pem \
            ${{ secrets.EC2_USERNAME }}@${{ secrets.EC2_HOST }} \
            "sudo cp /tmp/index.html /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html && sudo systemctl restart nginx"

      - name: Verify application
        run: |
          ssh -i ~/.ssh/hybrid-cloud-key.pem \
            ${{ secrets.EC2_USERNAME }}@${{ secrets.EC2_HOST }} \
            "curl -f http://localhost/"
